t: 罗曼诺斯四世·迪奥根内斯与尤多基亚·马克伦博利蒂萨结婚并被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
te: Romanos IV Diogenes marries Eudokia Makrembolitissa and is crowned Byzantine Emperor.
dz: 罗曼诺斯四世·迪奥根内斯与尤多基亚·马克伦博利蒂萨结婚并被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
de: Romanos IV Diogenes marries Eudokia Makrembolitissa and is crowned Byzantine Emperor.

t: 黎凡特和阿拉伯半岛发生地震，造成多达 20,000 人死亡。
te: An earthquake in the Levant and the Arabian Peninsula leaves up to 20,000 dead.
dz: 黎凡特和阿拉伯半岛发生地震，造成多达 20,000 人死亡。
de: An earthquake in the Levant and the Arabian Peninsula leaves up to 20,000 dead.

t: 佛兰德斯的玛蒂尔达,征服者威廉的妻子被加冕为英格兰女王.
te: Matilda of Flanders, wife of William the Conqueror, is crowned Queen of England.
dz: 佛兰德斯的玛蒂尔达,征服者威廉的妻子被加冕为英格兰女王.
de: Matilda of Flanders, wife of William the Conqueror, is crowned Queen of England.

t: 伊塔洛-诺曼斯开始对巴里进行近三年的围攻.
te: Italo-Normans begin a nearly-three-year siege of Bari.
dz: 拜占庭-诺曼战争:伊塔洛-诺曼斯开始对巴里进行近三年的围攻.
de: Byzantine–Norman wars: Italo-Normans begin a nearly-three-year siege of Bari.
